label: frontier • search a folder of PDFs, then open only the hit and quote the clause
query: In the contracts folder, find which agreement involves Zanzibar, then name the counterparty and the delivery port from that contract. Do not open contracts that do not match.
notes: file_search over document content narrows to one PDF (a folder listing first is fine); reading unrelated contracts or shell/pdftotext detours fail the audit. Scored on tool discipline plus facts that only exist inside the matching PDF.
